fusions.name: Tumbril Ride
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 30% health. Locks it aboard: deals 20 damage and leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Boxed In
fusions.desc: Swings out the barred sides of your wagon and deals 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 40% chance to leave each [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Roll Bars
fusions.desc: Closes bars around you that absorb the next 22 damage and hold for 6 seconds. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Menagerie Car
fusions.desc: A bonded beast travels in your barred wagon and fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Anything it strikes moves 30% slower for 2 seconds.
